purpose: Gives a custom control the standard label, helper and error layout, and links them to it with the right ARIA attributes.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, associated with the control

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error below the control; sets aria-invalid

props.name: required
props.description: Sets aria-required and shows the asterisk

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control and dims the label

props.name: children
props.description: Render prop that receives id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, aria-required and disabled; spread them onto the control

whenToUse: To wrap a control the design system does not provide, such as a colour picker or a third-party widget
whenNotToUse: Around Input, Select, Textarea and the other fields — they already include the layout
antiPatterns: Forgetting to spread the control props, which breaks the label and error links

anatomy: Label above, the custom control, helper text, error text with the report icon
sizes: Gaps `space-component-padding-xs`; the control sets its own size

a11yNotes: The render prop supplies the label id link, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and aria-required
